video.title_en: Discover what's next: The biggest updates from WWDC26 | Meet with Apple
video.title_zh: 发现未来:WWDC26 最重要的更新 | 与 Apple 面对面
video.description_en: Join us online as we highlight the latest updates across Apple platforms — and explore the benefits for your apps. We'll focus on the why over the how, mapping new technologies to real-world use cases. This session is for designers, product managers, and engineering leads who drive roadmap decisions.
video.description_zh: 在线加入我们,聚焦 Apple 全平台最重要的更新 — 并探索它们为你的应用带来的价值。我们关注「为什么」而非「怎么做」,把新技术映射到真实使用场景。本场面向设计师、产品经理和工程负责人,他们主导产品路线图的决策。

themes.title_zh: Apple Intelligence 2.0 — 基础模型框架
themes.desc_en: On-device 3B-param LLM as a single front door. Privacy-first inference. Same Swift API for on-device + cloud. Open-source. Tool calling, structured output, streaming.
themes.desc_zh: 端侧 30 亿参数大模型,统一入口。隐私优先的推理。同一个 Swift API 同时支持端侧和云端。开源。支持工具调用、结构化输出、流式响应。

themes.title_en: Liquid Glass Material — Major design language refresh
themes.title_zh: Liquid Glass 材质 — 重大设计语言革新
themes.desc_en: Refraction, depth, dynamic tinting. iPhone resizability. iPad resizable via Mac mirroring. Universal layout. Adopts iOS 27 → iPadOS 27 → macOS 27.
themes.desc_zh: 折射、深度、动态着色。iPhone 可调整尺寸。iPad 通过 Mac 镜像支持可调尺寸。通用布局。适配 iOS 27 / iPadOS 27 / macOS 27。

themes.desc_en: Whole-project context. Inline diffs. Multi-step editing. Live previews. Powered by Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Codex. Documentation-aware.
themes.desc_zh: 全项目上下文感知。内联 diff。多步编辑。实时预览。接入 Anthropic Claude、OpenAI GPT、Codex。文档感知。

themes.title_zh: Reality Composer Pro 3 + WebKit 沉浸式
themes.desc_en: Visual editor for 3D scenes, materials, animations. Node-based authoring. Particle effects. Cyberpunk 2077 ported via Game Porting Toolkit. WebKit grid lanes for immersive HTML.
themes.desc_zh: 3D 场景、材质、动画的可视化编辑器。基于节点的创作。粒子特效。Cyberpunk 2077 通过游戏移植工具包移植。WebKit 网格通道支持沉浸式 HTML。

themes.title_en: Core AI + Widgets + App Intents — Agentic UX
themes.title_zh: Core AI + Widgets + App Intents — Agentic 用户体验
themes.desc_en: Dynamic profiles for continuous conversation. Schemas/entities/schemas semantics. Smart Reply, Translation, Priority Notifications. Step-by-step guided experiences.
themes.desc_zh: 动态档案支持持续对话。Schema / 实体 / 语义。智能回复、翻译、优先通知。分步引导式体验。

themes.title_zh: App Store 27 — 发现、订阅、合购
themes.desc_en: 175 storefronts / 50 languages. Auto-generated preview assets. 900-point pricing tiers. 200 payment methods. Bundle TV/Arcade/iCloud. School Manager + enterprise volume.
themes.desc_zh: 175 个店面 / 50 种语言。自动生成的预览素材。900 档定价层级。200 种支付方式。TV / Arcade / iCloud 合购。学校管理员 + 企业批量采购。

windows.title_zh: 欢迎 + 回顾 WWDC26
windows.summary_en: Josh Tidsbury opens. WWDC26 was a big year — recap sessions, key announcements, AI throughout the platforms. Goal of this session: give you a clear vision of what's new and how to use it.
windows.summary_zh: Josh Tidsbury 开场。WWDC26 是大年 — 回顾各场 session、关键发布、AI 贯穿全平台。本场目标:让你清晰看到新特性,以及怎么用起来。

windows.title_zh: Apple Intelligence — 统一入口
windows.summary_en: Headline: there's now a model. Single front door to on-device, private, offline-capable inference. Fast because purpose-built silicon. Cloud compute for heavier lifts without giving up privacy. Common API: same Swift code points to on-device or cloud.
windows.summary_zh: 头条:现在有一个模型。统一入口,支持端侧、私密、可离线推理。因 Apple 自研芯片而极快。更重的负载走云端算力,却不牺牲隐私。统一的 Swift API:同一段代码可指向端侧或云端。

windows.title_en: Siri, Spotlight, App Intents + Liquid Glass
windows.title_zh: Siri、Spotlight、App Intents + Liquid Glass
windows.summary_en: App Intents escape the launch screen. Siri / Spotlight surface them where users already are. Liquid Glass design language evolves: depth, readability, tinted. iPhone resizability. iPad resizable via Mac mirroring.
windows.summary_zh: App Intents 突破启动屏限制。Siri / Spotlight 在用户当前场景直接调用。Liquid Glass 设计语言进化:层次、可读性、动态着色。iPhone 可调尺寸。iPad 通过 Mac 镜像支持可调尺寸。

windows.title_zh: Reality Composer Pro + Cyberpunk 2077 + WebKit
windows.summary_en: Spatial computing — Reality Composer Pro gets node-based animations + particle effects. CD Projekt Red ported Cyberpunk 2077 in months via Game Porting Toolkit. WebKit adds grid lanes for customizable immersive HTML.
windows.summary_zh: 空间计算 — Reality Composer Pro 加入基于节点的动画 + 粒子特效。CD Projekt Red 通过游戏移植工具包,几个月内移植 Cyberpunk 2077。WebKit 加入网格通道,支持可定制的沉浸式 HTML。

windows.title_en: Foundation Models — Guided Generation + Tool Calling
windows.title_zh: 基础模型 — 受控生成 + 工具调用
windows.summary_en: Beyond basic text: a 3-day Paris itinerary comes back structured. Guided Generation guarantees output structure (e.g. JSON types). Tool calling connects weather, calendar, personal context. Streaming enables real-time UI updates.
windows.summary_zh: 不只是文本生成:一个 3 天巴黎行程能直接以结构化形式返回。受控生成(Guided Generation)保证输出结构(JSON 类型等)。工具调用连接天气、日历、个人上下文。流式响应实现实时 UI 更新。

windows.title_zh: 第三方模型 + Vision Pro 生成式 AI
windows.summary_en: Provider protocol lets Anthropic / OpenAI / etc. packages plug in. Same task abstraction. Vision Pro now recognizes gestures, removes backgrounds, isolates voices — generative AI runs locally with smooth performance.
windows.summary_zh: 统一的 Provider 协议,Anthropic / OpenAI 等可插入。同一套任务抽象。Vision Pro 现在能识别手势、移除背景、分离人声 — 生成式 AI 本地运行,流畅体验。

windows.title_zh: Core AI + MLX + 开源权重模型
windows.summary_en: MLX: complete stack for ML deployment lifecycle. Open-weight, purpose-built. Unified memory accelerates M5. Hugging Face presence: 10,000+ supported models. Ollama, LM Studio, VLM integration.
windows.summary_zh: MLX:端到端机器学习部署生命周期栈。开源权重,专为 Apple Silicon 打造。统一内存加速 M5。Hugging Face 接入:支持 10,000+ 模型。Ollama、LM Studio、VLM 集成。

windows.title_zh: 动态档案 — 持续 Agent 对话
windows.summary_en: Travel planner demo: book flight → rebook hotel after delay → dynamic profile keeps the transcript + outputs active, maintains context. Enables multi-step agents across sessions without losing continuity.
windows.summary_zh: 旅行规划 demo:订机票 → 航班延误后改签酒店 → 动态档案保持对话记录 + 输出,维护上下文。实现跨 session 的多步 Agent,不丢失连续性。

windows.title_zh: 评测 — 可复现的质量衡量
windows.summary_en: Agents are unpredictable. Traditional unit tests insufficient. Grade evaluators: statistical analysis across diverse samples, including synthetically generated ones. Scales coverage without hand-writing every case.
windows.summary_zh: Agent 输出不确定。传统单元测试不够。评分评测器:跨多样样本的统计分析,包括合成生成样本。扩大覆盖范围而无需手工写每个测试用例。

windows.title_zh: Widget + 一眼即得集成
windows.summary_en: Widgets as step-by-step interfaces (coffee shop order tracker). ActivityKit for live progress. Siri voice actions. Widgets become conversation surfaces, not just dashboards.
windows.summary_zh: Widget 演化为分步界面(咖啡店订单追踪)。ActivityKit 支持实时进度。Siri 语音动作。Widget 不再是仪表盘,而是会话界面。

windows.title_zh: App Intents demo — 日历 + 事件
windows.summary_en: "Who's coming to stargazing?" — Siri finds event, attendees, drafts invite. Reschedule to noon → 11:30 a.m., Siri asks confirm. Heavy lifting done by App Intents — schema-aware.
windows.summary_zh: "谁会来观星?" — Siri 找到事件、参与者、起草邀请。改时间 noon → 11:30 a.m.,Siri 询问确认。重度工作由 App Intents 完成 — schema 感知。

windows.title_zh: App Entities — 屏幕感知
windows.summary_en: App Intents now understands entities currently on-screen. Identifies detail, refers to them conversationally. Photo album entities referenced in messages — `[[album name]]` becomes first-class.
windows.summary_zh: App Intents 现在理解屏幕上当前的实体。能识别细节,以对话方式引用它们。照片专辑实体在消息中被引用 — `[[专辑名]]` 变为一等公民。

windows.title_zh: Schema + 动作 + 预定义动作
windows.summary_en: Apple trained schemas on common domains: calendar, maps, media, camera, phone, clock. Dozens of predefined mappings from verbs to actions. You describe; the system knows.
windows.summary_zh: Apple 训练了常见领域的 schema:日历、地图、媒体、相机、电话、时钟。从动作到行为的几十个预定义映射。你描述,系统就懂。

windows.title_zh: 标注 → 请求流转
windows.summary_en: Tag views correspond to Siri's pixels on screen. Backing request continues to pull another. Walls between apps become fluid — Siri mediates across them. Contacts, calendar, notes all interop.
windows.summary_zh: 标签视图对应屏幕上的 Siri 像素。支撑请求持续拉取下一个。App 之间的墙变流动 — Siri 在它们之间调度。联系人、日历、备忘录全互通。

windows.title_en: Live demos — Cosmo Tunes, Unicorn Chat
windows.title_zh: 现场 demo — Cosmo Tunes、Unicorn Chat
windows.summary_en: Maho takes stage. Live demos of new App Intents + Core AI features in shipping apps. Identifying fastest-path interactions, building trust through real apps.
windows.summary_zh: Maho 上场。在已上架 App 中实时演示新的 App Intents + Core AI 特性。识别最快路径的交互,通过真实 App 建立信任。

windows.title_zh: iPad 可调尺寸 — 现代自适应
windows.summary_en: iOS resizes. Dedicated iPad version goes away. App adapts gracefully — anyone can resize window, layout reflows. Toolbar / sidebars reposition automatically. Modern adaptive design.
windows.summary_zh: iOS 支持可调尺寸。专用 iPad 版本不再需要。App 自适应 — 任何人都能调窗口,布局自动回流。工具栏 / 边栏自动重定位。现代自适应设计。

windows.title_zh: 自适应布局 — 紧凑堆叠
windows.summary_en: Aspect ratio classes — horizontal / vertical / compact / regular. Repositioning expands to fill, adjusts wider automatically. Figma design kit available. Persistent transitions between sizes.
windows.summary_zh: 长宽比类 — 水平 / 垂直 / 紧凑 / 标准。重定位自动扩展填充,自动调整宽度。Figma 设计套件可用。尺寸间过渡持续流畅。

windows.title_en: Liquid Glass visual details — refraction + depth
windows.title_zh: Liquid Glass 视觉细节 — 折射 + 深度
windows.summary_en: Separation between darken + brighter specular highlights. Slider for fine-tuning. Sidebar with beautiful refractions — scrolls and regains sharpness. Icon layers dial refraction, shadows, translucency.
windows.summary_zh: 暗化 + 高光之间的分离度。微调滑块。具有美丽折射的边栏 — 滚动后重新清晰。图标层调节折射、阴影、半透明。

windows.title_zh: Cursor + Agentic 编程(Xcode 27 深入)
windows.summary_en: Cursor works alongside you. Validates solutions, edits files, explains reasoning. Inline diffs. Approve / refine with fine-grain feedback. Documentation archive aware. Multi-step editing.
windows.summary_zh: Cursor 与你协作。验证方案、编辑文件、解释推理。内联 diff。批准 / 细化反馈粒度细。文档档案感知。多步编辑。

windows.title_zh: Xcode 27 — 可视化原型 + 调试
windows.summary_en: Visual directions. Prototyping — render incrementally, snapshots as you go. Localization prep — singular / plural aware. LLDB console logging. Simulators with security + approval.
windows.summary_zh: 可视化方向。原型设计 — 增量渲染,快照随做随存。本地化准备 — 单复数感知。LLDB 控制台日志。带安全 + 审批的模拟器。

windows.title_zh: App Store 27 — 发现 + 创意素材
windows.summary_en: 175 storefronts / 50 languages / 850M weekly visitors. Auto-generates page from creative assets. Showcases lifestyle imagery (yoga mat, dumbbells, hiker). Tells richer story, uplifts value.
windows.summary_zh: 175 个店面 / 50 种语言 / 8.5 亿周访客。从创意素材自动生成页面。展示生活方式图像(瑜伽垫、哑铃、徒步者)。讲述更丰富故事,提升价值。

windows.title_zh: App Store 27 — 定价 + 订阅
windows.summary_en: 900-point pricing tiers. 200 payment methods. Auto currency conversion. Paywall templates. Robust analytics. StoreKit 2 entitlements. Subscription reminders — free month to retain.
windows.summary_zh: 900 档定价层级。200 种支付方式。自动货币转换。付费墙模板。强大分析。StoreKit 2 entitlement。订阅提醒 — 赠送一个月以保留用户。

windows.title_zh: 合购 + 学校管理员 + 企业
windows.summary_en: Bundles — TV / Arcade / iCloud configurable. Volume purchasing. School Manager for education. Auto-renewable monthly. 12-month commitment for orgs. Renewal reminders + secure payments.
windows.summary_zh: 合购 — TV / Arcade / iCloud 可配置。批量采购。学校管理员用于教育。自动续订月度。组织 12 个月承诺。续订提醒 + 安全支付。

windows.title_zh: 提交 + 分发 + 营销活动
windows.summary_en: Streamlined submission. Batching submissions. Fall campaigns. Combat churn, acquire, drive engagement. WWDC26 snapshot — grow, simplify, hopefully inspire.
windows.summary_zh: 简化的提交流程。批量提交。秋季营销活动。对抗流失、获取用户、提升参与。WWDC26 全景 — 增长、简化、希望激发灵感。

windows.title_zh: 收尾 + WWDC26 全球活动
windows.summary_en: WWDC YouTube channel. Apple Developer forums. Labs. Apple Developer Centers. Berlin center recently opened. 10 p.m. approaching — snacks, beverages in the lobby. Q&A.
windows.summary_zh: WWDC YouTube 频道。Apple Developer 论坛。Lab 答疑。Apple Developer 中心。柏林中心新近开业。晚上 10 点将近 — 大堂有茶点。Q&A。

quotes.en: The headline is: there's a model now. You access it through a single front door — on-device, private, works offline.
quotes.zh: 头条是:现在有一个模型。你通过统一入口访问它 — 端侧、私密、可离线。

quotes.en: Inference is fast because it's running on purpose-built silicon. Cloud compute reaches for heavier loads without giving up privacy.
quotes.zh: 推理极快,因为跑在 Apple 自研芯片上。云端算力承接更重的负载,却不牺牲隐私。

quotes.en: A common API foundation framework allows you to point basically the same code at whichever you choose. Swift APIs, end-to-end.
quotes.zh: 统一的 API 基础框架让你能用基本相同的代码指向任何你选的。Swift API,端到端。

quotes.en: App Intents become something where, as the user discovers exactly what they need, it just appears and behaves across devices.
quotes.zh: App Intents 变得 — 当用户发现他们真正需要的东西时,它就出现并跨设备工作。

quotes.en: Returns a detailed plan in a natural way — beyond basic text generation. Guided Generation gives precise control over output structure.
quotes.zh: 以自然方式返回详细方案 — 远超基础文本生成。受控生成对输出结构提供精确控制。

quotes.en: Provider accessible via creating a package that conforms to a protocol. Anthropic packages extend this — making state-of-the-art run on-device.
quotes.zh: 第三方模型通过符合协议的 package 接入。Anthropic 的包扩展了这一点 — 让最先进模型在端侧运行。

quotes.en: MLX is a complete runtime — spanning the deployment life cycle. Open-weight, purpose-built, takes unified memory, accelerates with M5.
quotes.zh: MLX 是完整的运行时 — 覆盖部署全生命周期。开源权重、专为 Apple Silicon 打造、利用统一内存、由 M5 加速。

quotes.en: Dynamic Profiles handle what happens in session, preserving continuity through handoffs. Maintains a transcript of responses, outputs.
quotes.zh: 动态档案处理 session 内发生的事,跨交接保持连续性。维护响应和输出的对话记录。

quotes.en: You cannot rely on functional consistency — simple unit tests are insufficient. You need evaluators that grade with statistical trends.
quotes.zh: 你不能依赖功能一致性 — 简单单元测试不够。你需要评分评测器,以统计趋势打分。

quotes.en: Widgets become step-by-step — like tracking a coffee shop order. Integrate with action buttons. Stay useful, appearing in moments of friction.
quotes.zh: Widget 演化为分步界面 — 比如追踪咖啡店订单。与操作按钮集成。在摩擦时刻保持有用。

quotes.en: App Intents now understands entities currently on-screen — identifies and opens detail. Tries to refer rather than email.
quotes.zh: App Intents 现在理解屏幕上当前的实体 — 识别并打开细节。尝试引用而非发邮件。

quotes.en: Earlier showing said phrase — tag views correspond to what Siri sees on the pixels. Backing request continues to pull another.
quotes.zh: 之前展示的短语 — 标签视图对应 Siri 在屏幕上看到的像素。支撑请求持续拉取下一个。

quotes.en: iPad resizability — iOS resizes. The dedicated iPad version can go away. App resizes gracefully.
quotes.zh: iPad 可调尺寸 — iOS 可调尺寸。专用 iPad 版本可以消失。App 优雅地调整尺寸。

quotes.en: Liquid Glass — separation between darken and brighter specular highlights. Slider for fine-tune taste. Sidebars with beautiful refractions.
quotes.zh: Liquid Glass — 暗化与高光的分离。微调滑块。具有美丽折射的边栏。

quotes.en: Cursor works well-known partners — OpenAI, Claude, Codex. High-level drafts, written. Correct, expand, refine.
quotes.zh: Cursor 与知名伙伴协作 — OpenAI、Claude、Codex。高层草案、写就、修正、扩展、细化。

quotes.en: 175 storefronts, half a billion weekly visitors across 50 languages. Safe and trusted.
quotes.zh: 175 个店面、50 种语言、每周 5 亿访客。安全、可信。

quotes.en: 900-point pricing tiers updated for taxes and currencies. 200 payment options. Robust analytics and sales reporting.
quotes.zh: 900 档定价层级,自动适配税费与货币。200 种支付方式。强大分析与销售报告。
